description: Adversaries attempt to obtain a listing of other systems (by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifiers) on a network that may be used for lateral movement from the current system.
artifacts: ICMP echo requests (ping sweeps) to multiple internal hosts
ICMP echo replies or time-exceeded/unreachable responses (depending on topology/filtering)
sequential or patterned destination IP scanning behavior (host enumeration)
DNS A/AAAA queries for many internal hostnames (hostname-to-IP resolution for discovery)
NetBIOS Name Service (NBNS) queries and responses for host discovery (Windows environments)
SMB negotiation/session attempts (e.g., TCP/445) associated with commands like net view
RPC endpoint mapper connections (TCP/135) followed by subsequent dynamic RPC traffic (Windows enumeration workflows)
